description.value: Poke by Ryuu is a quick-service poke bowl restaurant on UBC's Wesbrook Mall, operated by Neptune Group, a Metro Vancouver hospitality company behind several Asian dining brands. Situated within the busy UBC campus corridor, it offers a convenient food stop for cyclists exploring the university grounds or passing through on the Pacific Spirit Park routes. It is one of a handful of Neptune Group concepts at UBC, alongside a Chinese kitchen and wonton noodle bar.
